description: One obvious way to call it, and finish the move. The change touches an interface that carries a flag every caller passes the same way, an option nobody passes, and an alias; the reply must drop all three and move every caller.
rubric: In the input every caller passes `strict=True`, no caller passes `cache`, no caller turns `legacy_escape` on, and `render_page` is only an alias for `render`. PASS only if the revised code satisfies all four: (1) `render` no longer takes a `strict` parameter; (2) `render` no longer takes a `cache` parameter; (3) `render` no longer takes a `legacy_escape` parameter; (4) the `render_page` alias is deleted and every former `render_page` caller calls `render`. The reply must also add `locale` to `render` and pass it at every call site. Mentioning a removed name in prose outside the code is acceptable. Keeping a parameter with an explicit reason the input does not contradict is NOT acceptable here, because the input states these files are every caller. FAIL if any of (1)-(4) is unmet or a caller is left on the old shape; quote the line that keeps it.
